title: T&T | Cyber: D&R | Consultant | Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) | Bengaluru
description:
**T&T | Cyber: D&R | Consultant | Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) | Bengaluru**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 114200
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks. Learn more about Cybersecurity

  

**Your work profile**

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Application & API VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing) Analyst with 3 to 5 years of experience in identifying, assessing, and validating security vulnerabilities across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and cloud-hosted applications. The candidate will be responsible for conducting security assessments, supporting remediation efforts, and helping enhance the organization's security posture.

* Perform Vulnerability Assessments and Penetration Testing (VAPT) on web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and microservices.
* Conduct security testing aligned with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, SANS Top 25, and CWE standards.
* Experience of Web Application Security Testing, Infrastructure VAPT, API testing.
* Understanding of AI/LLM concepts, Generative AI applications, and common AI application architectures.

### **Key Skills Required:**

* Total 2-4 years of experience in Cyber security domain
* Understanding of basic business and information technology management processes.
* Good knowledge of TCP/ IP and Networks including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Routers, Switches, and network architecture.
* Experience of Web Application Security Testing, Infrastructure VAPT, API testing.
* Basic understanding of AI/LLM concepts, Generative AI applications, and common AI application architectures.
* Knowledge of AI security testing methodologies, including Prompt Injection, Jailbreak Testing, sensitive data exposure, and system prompt leakage.
* Ability to assist in AI penetration testing of LLM-based applications, chatbots, and RAG-based solutions under defined testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with AI security testing tools, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and basic AI guardrail validation techniques. Relevant AI Security or AI Penetration Testing certifications would be an added advantage.
* Experience on Mobile Security Pen-Testing (iOS and Android).
* Experience in conducting Configuration reviews of Servers, Network devices, Windows, Linux, UNIX, Solaris, Databases, etc.
* Experience with Vulnerability Management and Penetration testing tools: Burp suite, Kali Linux, Acunetix, AppScan, Nexpose, Qualys Guard, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Fortify etc.
* Experience in basic scripting such as: Shell, Python, PERL, etc.
* Basic knowledge of Technoilogies such as: IPSEC, SSL, SSH, VPN, Ethernet Token Ring, WAP, SMTP, FTP, Frame Relay, WAN, ATM, FDDI, DSL, ISDN, HP Openview, Sun NetManage, Cisco Works, Radius, Big Brother, F5.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Professional is required to work from office .
* Preferred Certifications : OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
* OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert)
* GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester)
* eWPT / eWPTX / PNPT / CEH /CREST Certifications/ CISSP (Preferred for leadership positions)

* Web Applications
* APIs (REST, SOAP, GraphQL)
* Mobile Applications (iOS & Android)
* Cloud-hosted Applications
* Microservices-based Architectures
* Execute advanced penetration testing techniques to identify and exploit:

* Perform threat modeling and attack surface analysis.
* Validate vulnerabilities identified through SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.
* Conduct secure architecture and security design reviews.
* Perform cloud application security assessments on Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Support container and Kubernetes security assessments.

--------------------------------------------

* Manage and lead a team of VAPT consultants and security analysts.
* Review penetration testing reports and ensure quality deliverables.
* Allocate resources and manage multiple assessment engagements.
* Mentor junior team members on offensive security methodologies and best practices.
* Drive remediation discussions with application owners and development teams.
* Participate in customer and executive-level security review meetings.
* Track assessment metrics, remediation status, and risk reduction initiatives.

**Core Penetration Testing Skills Required**
--------------------------------------------

### **Application Security**

* Strong understanding of:
* OWASP Top 10
* OWASP API Security Top 10
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework

* Web Application Penetration Testing
* API Penetration Testing
* Mobile Application Security Testing
* Authentication and Access Control Testing
* Session Management Testing
* Business Logic Testing
* Manual Exploitation Techniques
* Source Code Assisted Testing

### **Infrastructure Security Knowledge**

* Network Penetration Testing
* Active Directory Security Assessments
* Internal and External Network Assessments
* Cloud Security Assessments
* Container Security Testing
  

**Key Skills Required:**

* 4-7 years of experience in Application Security and Penetration Testing.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or mentoring security teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale VAPT programs.
* Excellent report-writing and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
* **Preferred Certifications** **:** OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
* OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert)
